title: Shiraishi An — BBQ With Everyone♪〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Campground

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, skewers are on the fire!
Now to just wait for them to cook.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope they turn out well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Same.
Just don't them burn, alright, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Shut up! I won't!
I'm keeping a close eye on them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll help monitor them as well. It'd be a shame to have put in all that effort and not be rewarded...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: At the same time, it's very interesting to see how a person cooks can be an expression of their personality.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get what you mean.
Kohane's a total whiz with kitchen knives!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks...
It must be because I help my mom cook so often.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You seemed to know how to handle knives pretty well too, Shinonome. You did a great job peeling those potatoes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was just doing what I learned in home ec.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You did a good job too, Aoyagi.
You really made sure to curl in your fingers while you chopped.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'm glad I figured out how to.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I had so much trouble keeping everything from slipping and wasn't sure what I was doing wrong, but now I understand that it's a good way to keep my fingers safe.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: All that from learning how to use knives safely...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I noticed that you were using the same technique.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Because I don't want to hurt my fingers.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Excuse me. Where are my manners...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! I don't blame you! We did a lot today, so I bet you're starving!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too, actually...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hmm... Nothing's cooked through yet. Don't we have anything else to eat...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, how about these?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Mandarins...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! I was gonna have some for dessert, but we can eat them now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They're great for when you're snuggled up inside a kotatsu, so I bet they'll taste amazing since we have a cozy campfire.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How does that work?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Details. Details.
Here, knock yourselves out.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks, An.
If you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They smell very nice when you peel them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, these are really good.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, have you guys ever heard of orange peel art...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Orange peel art?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. It should come up pretty quick if you look it up on your phone. Also, to be fair, it's more like a fun activity as opposed to real art...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, here. I found some...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, that's pretty cool. They turned theirs into cats and rabbits.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
And this person made a kotatsu...
It's like the reverse of what we were just talking about.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Our food still probably needs a little more time, so why don't we give this a try?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that sounds fun!
Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to try as well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, I'll give it a shot.
But don't forget to keep an eye on the food.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay... Maintain a swirl pattern and...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh no, it ripped...!
Count Pearl's a lot harder to make than I realized.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Don't worry, Kohane!
We've got heaps more where that came from.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right. Thanks, An.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez, how many mandarins did you bring?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... Not quite ten...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Our neighbors gave us a whole box of them and we were having trouble going through them all, so Dad made me take some with me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see. Then, I'm glad he did.
Okay, mine's ready...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh wow! That's so cute!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Look at you, Toya!
Is it a dog and a bunny?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I put a lot of effort into getting the golden retriever's ears to bend properly. The same goes for how the carrot looks in the rabbit's mouth.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That reminds me. Weren't you in charge of making cotton candy art during the School Festival? I remember seeing bears and unicorns...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, those were so cute.
It's like Toya's legit artist, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, maybe...
I wish I could somehow keep them as they were.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hehe. I appreciate the compliment...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was the student while learning how to pitch a tent and build a campfire, but it's finally my turn to be the teacher.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That means you'll just have to teach us more about orange peel art the next time we go camping, Mr. Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, you plan on bringing these every time?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Why not?
They're good and we get to see Toya make these masterpieces!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (These were pretty heavy, but I'm glad I brought them...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I hope Toya and the rest of us can keep discovering our individual and collective talents like this...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, something smells really good. The skewers might be ready now...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, you guys!
It's time to dig into tonight's main dish!
